title: Partitions of canonical bases
summary: We show that various partitions of the canonical basis of quantum groups constructed by Lusztig and by Kashiwara coincide. Using this partition, we show that the subset corresponding to open Richardson varieties equals to the intersection of the subsets corresponding to the Schubert cells. We also show that in type $A$, the weights from open Richardson varieties are saturated in the corresponding Bruhat interval polytope.
